selection.reason: Previously reported 37 to 71 summaries, not selected from new results

checks: Reproduce both complete frozen bills and the unchanged control
First divergence has identical input, baseline, options, model and observed prefix bills
Explain switches preserve the original decisions and estimates
Decompose NOW and WAIT bill changes into input, summary and prewarm; ordinary output cancels
Recheck first 12 future non-forced states on candidate NOW path with frozen model, no-qualification incumbent, deployed incumbent and safety candidate
Show first 12 actual decisions after the fork separately from hypothetical projected states
Compare chosen forecast versus actual suffix using identical survival weights, not as a causal counterfactual
limits: Local diagnostic, not a new algorithm or proof that the first fork alone caused all later cost changes; no model/default/threshold changes
